ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Jupiter

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.
